name: bw-peek
description: A Beadwork ticket pane inside Claude Code: /bw <id> or a search box runs bw show and draws the digest, title, description and comments; every ticket id a reply mentions gets a button that opens it. Needs function hooks (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1).

mention_buttons.title: Ticket buttons under replies
mention_buttons.description: Draw a row of [ id ] buttons under every reply that mentions a Beadwork ticket

bare_mentions.title: Bare ids under replies
bare_mentions.description: Also draw a button for a bare id (c50, wxh.5) when it is a ticket on this repo's own board

mention_cap.title: Buttons per reply
mention_cap.description: Most ids drawn under one reply before '+N more' (1 to 20)

collapsed_rows.title: Description rows when collapsed
collapsed_rows.description: Rows of the description shown before [ Show all ] (3 to 40)

digest_chars.title: Comment digest length
digest_chars.description: Characters of each comment shown before its expand button (20 to 200)
